About the role
Illustrative Fintech (Pvt) Ltd builds payment software used by banks across South Asia. We're growing our Colombo engineering team and want graduates who love clean code.

What you will need
* A degree in Computer Science / Software Engineering (final-year undergraduates may apply)
* Solid grasp of Java 17, Spring Boot and Hibernate
* Comfortable writing SQL against PostgreSQL
* You use git daily and understand pull-request based workflows
* Clear communication in English

Bonus points
* Docker or any container tooling
* Some React

Apply via our careers page. Questions? hr@illustrative-fintech.example

We are looking for an enthusiastic QA Intern for a six-month internship.
Requirements
- Currently following a degree in IT or Software Engineering
- Understanding of the software development life cycle and how test cases are written
- Familiar with tools like JIRA
- Any exposure to Selenium or Postman would be an advantage
- Good attitude and teamwork
Location: Malabe. Interviews start in November.

Join the insights team of an illustrative supermarket chain. You will turn sales data into weekly dashboards for category managers.
You should have:
1. 1-2 years of experience with SQL (MS SQL Server preferred)
2. Strong knowledge of Power BI including DAX
3. Ability to explain numbers to non-technical people in Sinhala and English
4. Basic Python (pandas) is a plus
5. Knowledge of basic statistics
Salary: negotiable. Send CVs to analytics.jobs@illustrative-retail.example

Responsibilities: maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and Jenkins, manage Kubernetes clusters on AWS, and automate everything with Terraform.
Must have: Linux administration, Docker, scripting in Bash or Python.
Good to have: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, basic networking (DNS, load balancers).
Experience: 1+ year in a DevOps or systems role.

Illustrative Studio is hiring a graduate designer.
You will run user research sessions, sketch flows, and build high-fidelity prototypes in Figma.
We expect a portfolio with at least two case studies, good communication skills and the ability to work with front-end developers (HTML/CSS knowledge helps).

A leading illustrative ISP is recruiting trainees for its network operations centre.
Requirements:
- Completed or reading for a degree in IT / Networking
- CCNA level knowledge of routing, switching and VLANs
- Understanding of firewalls and basic cybersecurity concepts
- Willing to work on shifts
Training on Fortinet and Palo Alto devices will be provided.
Built apps with React Native, Spring Boot and Kubernets; deployed via CI/CD on AWS.
